name: Pre-mortem
description: Thirty minutes before a project starts: imagine it has failed, list what went wrong and how likely it is, then agree what to do about the biggest risks.

agenda.title: Imagine it failed. What went wrong?

slide.prompt: It’s six months from now and the project has failed. One reason per row: what went wrong, what we’d do about it, how likely it is.
notes: Say it as if it has already happened: “the launch slipped because…”. It gets more honest answers than “what might go wrong?”.
Write first, talk second: two minutes of quiet writing before anyone shares.
